routes.useWhen: Starting a Touying deck or checking current slide, animation, and speaker-note syntax.
Using pause, meanwhile, only, uncover, or basic subslide behavior.
Using callback slides, repeat, or explicit subslide-dependent content.
Using named animation positions without hard-coded subslide indices.
Checking section, subsection, heading-triggered slide, or page break behavior.
Resolving a focused Touying API or behavior question not covered by a tutorial.
